cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I wasn't just late to the reunion. Can I tell you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat beside me. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. No. I waited outside for half an hour. Can you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. But I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd be happier without me there. Will you sit beside me now?

cardFidelity.evidence: A3/A5 progressively disclose fear but do not perform professional correction beyond the stock preface.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's traffic explanation is rejected; B4's feeling of rejection earns A5's admission of fearing exclusion.

relationship.evidence: B4 shares a genuine hurt and remains present.

heightening.evidence: A5 risks a deeper admission and immediately tests continued closeness.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a reunion and B2 a saved neighboring seat.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's slowly phrase interrupts the admission without a clear purpose.

coach2.situation: A1 establishes a reunion and B2 a saved neighboring seat.
coach2.stated: A3 waited outside for half an hour; B2 saved a seat; B4 thought A did not want it.
coach2.inferred: The fear of being unwanted is subjective, not proof B preferred A absent.
coach2.missing: No essential missing fact; the professional role is thin.
coach2.firstDefect: A1's generic professionally phrase does not earn S03.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 offers a benign reason for A1's late arrival.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 corrects B2 with the fact of waiting outside.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 shares the interpretation caused by A3's absence.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 answers B4's hurt with the more vulnerable reason and asks for company.

coach2.mechanism: A3/A5 progressively disclose fear but do not perform professional correction beyond the stock preface.

reservation: Do not turn B's openness into hostility merely to create pressure.
